**Do not describe a suspected vulnerability here.** Public issues are
visible to everyone immediately.

Report privately instead, through either channel:

- **GitHub private vulnerability reporting** —
  <https://github.com/trentpower/trentpower.fr/security/advisories/new>
  (stays between you and the maintainer until a fix is published)
- **Encrypted email** — contact published in
  <https://trentpower.fr/.well-known/security.txt>, PGP key at
  <https://trentpower.fr/.well-known/pgp-key.asc>
  (fingerprint `A729 591B 450D 3F59 3694 98BD 8299 1F25 04AE 0263`)

See [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) for the full reporting policy.
If you opened this form by accident, please close it without filing.
